messages:
pagerbot: PAGER: auth anomaly detected for svc-ingest-prod in us-west-2 — repeated refresh token replays. Alert sig: 7f3a9c. Link: https://internal/alerts/4523141592
mira (sec): saw the pager, starting triage. spikes of 401 + replay patterns, low success but many retries.
sam (oncall): on it, pulling traces and recent deploys now.
mira (sec): quick look at logs shows fragments of `X-Auth-Token` in forwarded payloads — possible log leak from indexer-forwarder.
devon (infra): I pushed a config change to log-forwarder ~2h ago (rollout id rf-2026-211). rolling back sink to stop external writes.
mira (sec): pausing external sinks per runbook step 1. also toggling log redaction.
nidhi (cs): any immediate customer impact? metrics not showing failed requests at app layer, mostly auth rejects. I'll standby for comms draft.
sam (oncall): quick query: `select count(*) from auth_events where event_type='token_replay' and service='svc-ingest' and ts > now() - interval '15 minutes'` -> 237 rows.
incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-9873 and PagerBridge channel #inc-INC-2026-9873, owner: mira (sec).
mira (sec): action items: 1) rotate svc-ingest-prod service account keys. 2) revoke sessions/tokens issued in last 24h. 3) scrub/redact any logs in S3 that include auth headers. 4) notify Legal + CS. 5) preserve evidence for forensics.
zoe (legal): acknowledged. preserve raw artifacts; do not delete anything until we've captured copies. I will coordinate retention and scope.
sam (oncall): starting key rotation: running `aws iam rotate-access-keys --service-account svc-ingest-prod --region us-west-2` (dry-run -> ok), proceeding with rotation and deploy.
mira (sec): run broad grep for header exposures: `egrep -R "X-Auth-Token: \S{10,}" /var/log/forwarder/*` then mark buckets for scrub: `s3://forwarder-archives/*`. Use scrubbing job `scrub-logs --pattern "X-Auth-Token" --replace "[REDACTED]"`.
devon (infra): changed forwarder sink to internal-only, hotfix deployed, ETA ~12m for rollout.
nidhi (cs): drafting customer note: "We observed anomalous auth attempts against internal ingestion service. No customer data access detected. We are rotating keys and scrutinizing logs; will update in 1h." Sending to mira + zoe for approval.
sam (oncall): rotation completed for svc-ingest-prod keys. New key id AKIA2F... deployed to instances behind dedicated pool.
mira (sec): revoking existing sessions: `authctl revoke --filter service=svc-ingest-prod --since 24h` -> 4,312 sessions revoked.
zoe (legal): please produce a list of potentially exposed artifacts and include S3 object paths and timestamps for my report.
mira (sec): hypothesis: a forwarder config change accidentally stopped header redaction and forwarded full auth headers. mitigation path: scrub S3, rotate keys, patch forwarder to enforce redaction, add integration test.
devon (infra): will add a preflight redaction check in CI and a linter for forwarder configs. Opening PR now.
nidhi (cs): customers notified via status page and targeted emails to affected accounts. CS triage channel created #cs-INC-2026-9873.
sam (oncall): handing off operational lead to devon for remediation and PM of postmortem. I'll remain as escalation contact. @devon take ownership.
devon (infra): ack — taking ownership. compiling timeline and mitigation steps. docs: https://docs/internal/INC-2026-9873-timeline
mira (sec): keeping channel for live updates. please paste any forensic outputs here (hashes, object keys). preserve evidence per @zoe. :thumbsup:
